faults.page says: The extract names only the legal entity 'Мультимедийный комплекс актуальных искусств' (state budgetary institution of the city of Moscow, founder Moscow acting through the Department of Culture); it never names the Multimedia Art Museum. The tie between that entity and MAMM sits on https://mamm.art/museum/documents/, which is not cited.
